tagline: Ukrainian directory and live monitor for Minecraft, Discord & gaming servers
description: Monicore is a Ukrainian catalog and live server monitor for active Discord, Minecraft, Hytale, Rust, and GTA communities. Features live online player counts, community reviews, rankings, trends, and free server submissions.
features: Live online monitoring for Ukrainian Minecraft & Discord servers
Community reviews, ratings, and trending lists
Free server submission for community owners
